values.name: Export
values.description: Export The transport movement is to export the goods from the country.

values.name: Import
values.description: Import The transport movement is to import the goods into the country.

values.name: Transit
values.description: Transit The cargo is moving in transit through a country and will not become part of the commerce of that country.

values.name: Relay
values.description: Relay The cargo is being moved by more than one transport means in succession under the responsibility of the same carrier.

values.name: Transshipment
values.description: Transshipment The cargo is being moved by more than one transport means in succession.
